description: This file contains unit tests for the HelpService class within the OrangeHRM's Help plugin module. It tests methods related to retrieving help configuration, generating redirect URLs, and URL validation, using mock objects and simulated HTTP responses.

classes.name: HelpServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HelpService, testing URL retrieval, configuration access, and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates HelpService instance, sets fixture path, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetZendeskHelpProcessor
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpProcessor returns an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests that getRedirectUrl returns the correct article URL from mocked HTTP response.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Tests that getRedirectUrl defaults to base help URL when no specific article is found.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Checks that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the expected base help URL.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl
methods.description: Verifies that isValidUrl confirms the current help URL as valid.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl2
methods.description: Checks that isValidUrl returns false when the help URL is invalid according to getBaseHelpUrl mock.
